text:
**The basics**

Before I plan anything, I need to know who I'm taking in hand.

prompt: How deep should this intake go?
hint: Light keeps it to the essentials; Medium builds a solid profile; Deep adds the introspective layers — what this actually is for you, what turns you on about it, where the friction lives. You can always go deeper in chat later.

prompt: Is there a name you go by in this — one you use, or want to use?
hint: Plenty of you have one; plenty don't. This just tells me which.
choices: No — and I don't want a separate name; my everyday one is the name
No — but I'd want you to pick one for me

prompt: Then what do I call you?

any.equals: No — and I don't want a separate name; my everyday one is the name

hint: The name you just told me about, or your everyday name if you don't have a separate one.

prompt: And when I speak of you — to you, about you, in audio — which is it?
hint: No wrong answer. 'You decide' hands it to me.
choices: She/her when we play — he/him the rest of the time

prompt: Your build, height, weight, and any other body related details you want to share.
hint: Rough numbers are fine; exact ones aren't required. I use this to know what we can work on.
